def balanced(s):
    """Return True when every (, [ and { in s is closed by the matching
    bracket in the right order.

    Text inside double-quoted strings is ignored. Inside such a string a
    backslash escapes the next character, so \" does not end the string.
    An unterminated string makes the whole input unbalanced.
    """
    pairs = {')': '(', ']': '[', '}': '{'}
    stack = []
    i = 0
    n = len(s)

    while i < n:
        c = s[i]

        if c == '"':
            # Skip the whole string literal.
            i += 1
            closed = False
            while i < n:
                ch = s[i]
                if ch == '\\':
                    i += 2  # skip the escaped character too
                    continue
                if ch == '"':
                    closed = True
                    i += 1
                    break
                i += 1
            if not closed:
                return False
        elif c in '([{':
            stack.append(c)
            i += 1
        elif c in ')]}':
            if not stack or stack[-1] != pairs[c]:
                return False
            stack.pop()
            i += 1
        else:
            i += 1

    return not stack


if __name__ == '__main__':
